title: Yuu Duel Momentum
description: PvP kill-chain momentum stacks with temporary buffs.
body:
# Yuu Duel Momentum

PvP kill-chain momentum stacks with temporary buffs.

## Features
- Consecutive PvP kills build momentum stacks.
- Stacks grant speed and strength with configurable scaling.
- Automatic decay creates pressure to keep momentum alive.
- Great for arena or faction combat pacing.

## Command
- `/duelmomentum [status|reset|reload]`

## Permission
- `yuuduelmomentum.use`

## Compatibility
- Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
- Game versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1

## Notes
- Lightweight implementation with configurable behavior in `config.yml`.
- Built by **yuutaxd**.
